description:
Start paid MiniMax relight using an owned video and an owned lighting-sphere reference image.

First call estimate_video_relight with the same media and settings. max_cost_rub is required and
must cover the maximum hold. No camera, LightX, duration, audio or safety controls are accepted.
Original audio is preserved; prompt is stored in history only. Returns a job ID; read get_video.
Even a completed job/webhook may have is_hold=true: poll get_video until is_hold=false for final cost.

max_cost_rub.description: Maximum hold confirmed from the relight estimate; never exceeded.
max_cost_rub.title: Max Cost Rub

prompt.description: History label only; lighting is controlled by reference_image_url.
prompt.title: Prompt

reference_image_url.description: Lighting sphere image from your own uploads or results.
reference_image_url.title: Reference Image Url

video_url.description: Source video from your own uploads or results; at most 15 seconds.
video_url.title: Video Url
